description: Searches print products by keyword (e.g. "biglietti da visita", "adesivi trasparenti", "roll up"). The catalog is in Italian and Italian words work best; plurals, some typos and the most common English words (stickers, business cards, flyers) are understood, words that match no product are dropped, and a query_relaxed message lists the words corrected or ignored. For each product: its materials, each priced at the website's default configuration for the pack named in the variant title (metadata.reference_quantity pieces) with economy shipping, in euro cents VAT included (VAT excluded, as the product page shows it, in metadata.price_excl_vat), excluding shipping, packaging and payment-method fees (e.g. cash on delivery), which the website adds at checkout; product page link, image. The price is not linear in the quantity: use get_product for sizes and options, and price_configuration for the exact price of another quantity.
name: search_catalog
